name: What's the difference between a repair consultation and a full roof replacement estimate?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a repair consultation and a full roof replacement estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A repair consultation focuses specifically on addressing localized damage to extend the life of your existing roof. A full roof replacement estimate, conversely, assesses the entire roof system to determine the feasibility and cost of installing a completely new roof. The consultation helps determine if repair is a viable, cost-effective option versus replacement, considering factors like overall roof condition and age.
acceptedAnswer.description: A repair consultation addresses localized damage, while a replacement estimate evaluates installing a completely new roof. It helps weigh repair vs. replacement viability.
